output.summary: Perennial flowering herbs or small shrubs native to East Asia and northeastern Europe, with most species originating in East Asia. They bloom in autumn and bear white, yellow or red outer florets around yellow centres; cultivated forms include many additional colours and shapes.
output.edibilityNote: Leaves are steamed or boiled as greens; flowers may flavour dishes, while C. morifolium flowers are boiled for tea in parts of East Asia.
